description: Cruise ship sail-aways in Florida: which ships leave PortMiami, Port Everglades, Port Canaveral and Port Tampa Bay today, tomorrow or this week (from the ports' own published schedules), the posted departure time where the port posts one (Miami, Canaveral), and when each passes the best public spots to watch it go by (South Pointe Park at Miami; Dr. Von D. Mizell-Eula Johnson State Park at Fort Lauderdale; Jetty Park at Canaveral; Sparkman Wharf and the Skyway Fishing Pier at Tampa). Use it for 'can we watch the cruise ships leave', sail-away parties on land, or when a cruiser's family wants to wave them off.

days.description: Or how many days ahead (1 to 14)
